items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: we made a recording out there with Bumps Blackwell with Slim. We was in the studio out there for specialty.

ctx.x: Wow. Did, it seemed to be, when you played piano, I mean mostly you were sideman. You were a sideman.

I've always been a sideman. I made a, we made a recording out there with Bumps Blackwell with Slim. We was in the studio out there for specialty. And Bumps wanted me to play something funky over there, God. So I just came up with a little idea. And the day I recorded it I really wasn't into it, you know. I was just playing something funky on the piano, you know. And then later on he called it King Cotton. And on one side, on one side it had heavy sugar. But Bumps Blackwell he butchered that song up man. It really…
